title: The Best Way to Start a New Habit
coreMove: Attach the next habit to a precise existing cue so starting has a visible address.
sourcePressure: New habits start better when the cue is highly specific and attached to a stable routine or context.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Writing a broad intention instead of choosing an exact cue and location.

hook: starting with a definition of implementation intention
counterintuition: the problem is not motivation alone

exampleSpecs.domain: a courthouse interpreter stacking breathing practice after badge scan
exampleSpecs.audience: a bilingual interpreter facing tense morning hearings
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a new calming routine starts because the cue is exact
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after the security badge chirps, she steps to the same marble column and takes three measured breaths
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a courthouse badge scanner flashing green

exampleSpecs.domain: a marine biologist logging salinity after rinsing field boots
exampleSpecs.audience: a field researcher missing data entries
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the stable boot-rinse cue carries the log habit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes the salinity number while the boots still drip in the tray
exampleSpecs.firstImage: muddy waders dripping into a blue tray

exampleSpecs.domain: a youth soccer referee doing ankle mobility after setting corner flags
exampleSpecs.audience: a weekend referee with recurring ankle pain
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the existing setup ritual becomes the start signal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he plants the fourth flag, then performs the mobility sequence before leaving the corner
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red corner flag stuck in wet turf

exampleSpecs.domain: a court stenographer starting wrist stretches after plugging in the machine
exampleSpecs.audience: a stenographer entering six-hour testimony blocks
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a precise equipment cue beats a vague health intention
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the cable clicks into the outlet and she starts the stretch before opening the case notes
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a stenotype cable coiled beside a courtroom outlet

exampleSpecs.domain: a food-truck owner checking propane after hanging the menu board
exampleSpecs.audience: a solo operator whose lunch rush fails when setup gets chaotic
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a stack prevents missed equipment checks
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he reconstructs the failed rush and moves the propane check to the moment the menu board hook closes
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a chalk menu board swinging from a truck window

exampleSpecs.domain: a ceramics student cleaning the wheel after placing each finished bowl on the ware board
exampleSpecs.audience: a beginner who leaves clay drying overnight
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the finished-bowl cue starts cleanup automatically
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: her instructor asks what always happens before the mess is forgotten, and she chooses the ware-board placement as the anchor
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a wet clay bowl lifted onto a ware board

skillTargets: choose stable anchors for habit stacking

tryThisNowSpec: Attach one new action to a cue that already happens daily. Write it in the form: After I _____, I will _____ at _____.
